lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters are visible posterior to the gill slits, arranged in a staggered grid pattern across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of blobs, creating a grid-like lattice of anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, defined by a sharp vertical pixel gradient with highlights on the superior edge and shadows on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The right pectoral fin displays a dense distribution of high-luminance spots that are smaller and more irregularly spaced than the flank constellations.
